title: Fresh-eyes review of the project-scaffold branch diff
why: Prevents the author of a change from being its only reviewer. A seat that wrote the code reads it the way it meant it, not the way it is; a separate seat with no write access reads the diff cold and can only report, so a review cannot quietly turn into a rewrite.

trigger.condition: The integration gate is green on the final tree of the scaffold branch and the orchestrator is about to open the pull request.

gates.why: The reviewer confirms the suite for itself rather than trusting the builder's report of it.
Public repository: an added line carrying a home path, an email, a registry owner or an IP address is a leak, whoever wrote it.

exit.condition: A findings report is written to the state directory naming each finding with file, line, severity and the failure it would cause, or stating plainly that there are none, and the seat's last act is bin/seat-record.sh clean|findings --set findings=<n> --set report=<path>.

on_failure.action: Report the file and line to the owner as ALERT. Do not fix it; the reviewer has no write access by design.

on_failure.case: a finding needs a code change
on_failure.action: Report it with file, line and the failure it causes. The orchestrator routes it to a builder seat.
